scope: Targeted primary-source implementation and overlap check, not a systematic literature review or a novelty certificate.

primary_sources_inspected.use: Confirmed the same normal-length, ray-precision and opacity-coefficient backward source patterns. Main is mutable, upstream history and author intent were not inspected.
Confirmed the corresponding forward normalization, ray precision and compensation definitions.
GGGS method and supplementary context. Diagnosing shader chain rules does not invalidate its high-level implicit median-depth identity.
Opacity compensation is established antialiasing functionality; no new compensation formulation is claimed here.

retrieval_limits: An attempted direct open of the splax documentation returned an internal error; search snippets alone were not used as evidence for a derivative claim.

Dynamic-scene papers with non-conservative mechanical forces were returned by search. That meaning differs from integrability of an optimization VJP; they were not treated as direct prior art for this diagnosis.
No result absence implies novelty. Broader issue, commit-history, mathematical differentiation and related-renderer review remains outstanding.
claim_boundary: Exact calculus and independent local CUDA checks support implementation inconsistency relative to forward. Quality and academic novelty require separate evidence.
